name: 2 Samuel
lede: The tenth book of the Bible, in full: David king in Hebron and in Jerusalem, the ark brought up with dancing, Bath-sheba and Nathan, Absalom's rebellion, and the threshing-floor of Araunah, every word in the words of the ASV.

books.name: How Are the Mighty Fallen
books.blurb: The Amalekite out of Saul's camp with the crown and the bracelet; David rends his clothes; the song of the bow — how are the mighty fallen!; David anointed king over Judah in Hebron and Ish-bosheth made king at Mahanaim; the twelve by the pool of Gibeon, Asahel light of foot as a wild roe, and Abner's cry: shall the sword devour for ever?

books.name: Abner
books.blurb: Long war between the house of Saul and the house of David; Abner's wrath — am I a dog's head?; Michal taken from Paltiel, who followed her weeping to Bahurim; Abner's league and the feast in Hebron; Joab takes him aside in the gate; David follows the bier: should Abner die as a fool dieth?; Mephibosheth lamed in the flight, and Ish-bosheth slain at noon.

books.name: The City of David
books.blurb: All the tribes at Hebron — we are thy bone and thy flesh — and David anointed king over Israel; the stronghold of Zion; Hiram's cedar; Baal-perazim and the sound of marching in the tops of the mulberry-trees; the ark on a new cart and Uzzah at the threshing-floor of Nacon; David dancing before Jehovah with all his might, and Michal at the window.

books.name: For Ever
books.blurb: I dwell in a house of cedar, but the ark of God dwelleth within curtains: the word of Jehovah to Nathan by night — I took thee from the sheepcote; he shall build a house for my name, and I will establish the throne of his kingdom for ever; David before Jehovah: who am I?; and David's wars from the Philistines to the River.

books.name: Mephibosheth
books.blurb: Is there yet any that is left of the house of Saul, that I may show him kindness for Jonathan's sake?; Ziba; Mephibosheth fallen on his face — fear not; he shall eat at my table as one of the king's sons; Hanun shames David's servants — tarry at Jericho until your beards be grown; Joab before Rabbah: be of good courage, and let us play the man.

books.name: Thou Art the Man
books.blurb: At the time when kings go out to battle David tarried at Jerusalem; the roof at eventide and Bath-sheba; Uriah sleeping at the king's door; the letter sent by Uriah's hand; the poor man's one little ewe lamb — thou art the man; I have sinned against Jehovah; the child's seventh day, Solomon whom Jehovah loved, and the crown of Rabbah.

books.name: Absalom
books.blurb: Amnon's sickness for his sister Tamar and Jonadab's subtle counsel; Tamar's cakes, the shut door, and her garment of divers colors rent; Absalom's two full years and the shearers' feast at Baal-hazor; Absalom fled to Geshur; the wise woman of Tekoa — we must needs die, and are as water spilt on the ground; and no blemish in him from the sole of his foot to the crown of his head.

books.name: The Mount of Olives
books.blurb: Absalom beside the way of the gate — oh that I were made judge in the land — steals the hearts of the men of Israel; Absalom is king in Hebron; arise, and let us flee; Ittai: whether for death or for life; the ark carried back over the Kidron; David going up the mount of Olives weeping and barefoot; Ziba's asses, Shimei's stones, and Ahithophel's counsel.

books.name: O My Son Absalom
books.blurb: Ahithophel's counsel defeated by Hushai's — as a bear robbed of her whelps; the priests' sons hidden in the well at Bahurim; over the Jordan by morning light; Barzillai's gifts at Mahanaim; deal gently for my sake with the young man; the forest of Ephraim; Absalom taken up between heaven and earth; Ahimaaz outruns the Cushite; O my son Absalom!

books.name: The King Returned
books.blurb: The victory turned into mourning, and Joab: thou lovest them that hate thee; the king sitting in the gate; brought back over the Jordan — Shimei forgiven, Mephibosheth unwashed, Barzillai fourscore years old; the ten parts in the king; Sheba's trumpet — every man to his tents, O Israel; Amasa at the great stone in Gibeon; and the wise woman of Abel.

books.name: Jehovah Is My Rock
books.blurb: Three years of famine and the Gibeonites; Rizpah on her sackcloth upon the rock from harvest until the rain; the bones of Saul and Jonathan brought home to Zela; the four sons of the giant — that thou quench not the lamp of Israel; and David's song: Jehovah is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer.

books.name: Which Cost Me Nothing
books.blurb: The last words of David — as the light of the morning, when the sun riseth; the mighty men, and the water of the well of Beth-lehem poured out unto Jehovah; the numbering of the people; Gad and the three things; the pestilence and the angel by the threshing-floor — it is enough; and the altar on Araunah's floor: neither will I offer burnt-offerings unto Jehovah my God which cost me nothing.
